hints: The angle $BAC$ is between the displacement vectors $\overrightarrow{AB}$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}$, not the position vectors themselves.
Subtract position vectors to form $\overrightarrow{AB}=(2,-2,1)$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}=(4,0,-3)$.
Use $\cos\theta=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AC}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}|\,|\overrightarrow{AC}|}$ and simplify the exact ratio.
walkthrough:
Calculate the displacement vectors $\overrightarrow{AB}$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}$ from the given position vectors:
$$\overrightarrow{AB} = \overrightarrow{OB} - \overrightarrow{OA} = \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ 1 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} - \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 3 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ -2 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$$
$$\overrightarrow{AC} = \overrightarrow{OC} - \overrightarrow{OA} = \begin{pmatrix} 5 \\ 3 \\ -2 \end{pmatrix} - \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 3 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 4 \\ 0 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix}$$

Calculate $\cos\angle BAC$ using the scalar product formula:
$$\cos\angle BAC = \dfrac{\overrightarrow{AB} \cdot \overrightarrow{AC}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}||\overrightarrow{AC}|} = \dfrac{5}{3 \times 5} = \dfrac{5}{15} = \dfrac{1}{3}$$

hints: Use the triangle area formula $\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}|\,|\overrightarrow{AC}|\sin\angle BAC$.
From part (a), convert $\cos\angle BAC=\tfrac13$ into a positive exact sine using $\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta=1$.
Use $|\overrightarrow{AB}|=3$ and $|\overrightarrow{AC}|=5$, then simplify the resulting surd.
walkthrough:
Find the exact value of $\sin\angle BAC$ from $\cos\angle BAC = \dfrac{1}{3}$ using the identity $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$:
$$\sin\angle BAC = \sqrt{1 - \cos^2\angle BAC} = \sqrt{1 - \left(\dfrac{1}{3}\right)^2} = \sqrt{1 - \dfrac{1}{9}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{8}{9}} = \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}$$

Apply the area formula for triangle $ABC$:
$$\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2}|\overrightarrow{AB}||\overrightarrow{AC}|\sin\angle BAC$$

Simplify the product by canceling factors:
$$\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 15 \times \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3} = \dfrac{30\sqrt{2}}{6} = 5\sqrt{2}$$
